_comment: A REPAIR KIT, AND THE ONLY ROUTE (owner, playtest 2026-09-07: "remove the recipes that don't
take broken terminals. Enrich the recipe to take parts that would be expected to be used to
repair a terminal, like circuits or something").
THIS REVERSES THE CALL MADE IN #406 AND THE REVERSAL IS THE OWNER'S. That PR kept a plain
recipe beside the repair, on the grounds that the Buy Terminal is the only source of every
Blueprint and the Sell Terminal the only source of scrip, so requiring a 1-in-16 Bulky Waste
find puts the whole progression spine behind a roll. The concern was raised, the owner ruled,
and what it actually buys is worth stating: a terminal now reads as a thing you FOUND and
fixed rather than a thing you fabricated, which is the mod's premise applied to its own shop
counter. The rate limit is real - see the note below.
The parts are what a dead terminal is missing rather than a generic pile of scrap: the screen
is a Bulb behind two Glass Shards, the boards are E-Scrap - this world's circuitry, and the
one that is household-tier, where Fused Circuitry is depths-side and Circuit Powder needs a
Pulverizer - and the casing is what distinguishes which terminal you get.
WHAT MAKES THIS SAFE IS THE FIND RATE, NOT THE RECIPE. A Broken Terminal is 1 in 16 Bulky
Waste, and Bulky Waste is 5 percent of a mound's surface, so it is a thing you meet early and
often rather than a wall. If that ever stops being true this is the first recipe to revisit,
because everything the market gates is downstream of it.
